lines.text: The quiz was a piece of cake.

data.define: Used for something that is very easy to do.

example.text: The quiz was a piece of cake.

misuse.text: Don't call a hard exam 'a piece of cake'.
misuse.why: It means easy, so you'll sound arrogant.

publish.title: What does "piece of cake" mean?
publish.value: Piece of cake = That was very easy. Example: "The quiz was a piece of cake." (casual English).
